text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby has
finally
arrived, and Матиканэфукукитару
burns with
eagerness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Always in her element to ward off evil
spirits,
Matikanefukukitaru is confident
that this monster
of a Derby will not
overwhelm her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She heads to the track determined to
push herself
to her limits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
